title: Concept: delegatecall to a variable target (solidity) — review required
description: In solidity, a delegatecall runs foreign code against the caller storage. Storage slots line up by position, so a hostile target can overwrite ownership variables. The remedy is a fixed, owner-set implementation address.
applicability: solidity contracts using delegatecall; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Storage takeover and fund loss when the target is attacker-influenced; HIGH severity.
